tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the podcast repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills; tests fixture-only.

OWNED FILES (only these; both exist at HEAD — read fully before editing):
  scripts/funnel_evidence.py
  tests/test_funnel_evidence.py

LIVE DEFECT (found in the first production run, 2026-08-03): the collect subcommand maps EVERY inbound Gmail message to a touch, so the ledger rebuild auto-added ~40 non-guest senders (Shutterstock, HubSpot billing, Product Hunt newsletters, vendors) as funnel people, and the controller then emitted nudge_due items telling the guest lane to respond to them. Vendors and newsletters must NEVER enter the guest funnel ledger.

FIX — deterministic relevance gating, no LLM:
1. collect gains --roster <path...> (repeatable; the lane will pass episodes/CANDIDATE-INBOX.json and episodes/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json when present). Build a KNOWN-PEOPLE index from those files: every person's normalized name (casefold, strip punctuation/extra spaces) AND any email found in their records. A Gmail message maps to a touch ONLY when its from_email or normalized from_name matches the index (also match 'first-name last-name' contained in the sender name). Outbound messages (from ankit@mybcat.com) map to a touch only when a known person appears in the message's to/recipient field if available, else drop with no note.
2. Unknown INBOUND senders are NOT dropped silently and NOT added as touches: collect writes them into EV.json under "unclassified": [{"person": sender name or email, "at": iso8601, "hint": subject truncated to 60 chars}] — deduped by sender. Obvious machine mail (sender email local-part or name matching no-reply/noreply/newsletter/billing/notifications/marketing/support/team@/hello@ patterns, case-insensitive) is dropped entirely with a count in "machine_dropped": N. Everything else lands in unclassified for the runbook lane (an LLM) to triage.
3. The focus subcommand threads this through AUTOMATICALLY: it passes <state-dir>/CANDIDATE-INBOX.json and <state-dir>/FUNNEL-LEDGER.json (each only when it exists) as rosters to collect, so the lane wiring needs NO new flags. FOCUS-LIST.json gains "unclassified_inbound": N and, when N>0, ONE focus item {kind: "classify_inbound", person_or_episode: "inbox-triage", reason: "N unclassified inbound sender(s) need guest-relevance triage", priority: after hold_expired items, before nudge_due}. The chain receipt records unclassified and machine_dropped counts. The ledger rebuild call MUST pass evidence whose touches now contain only known people, so unledgered_added returns to meaning 'known-person evidence missing from ledger' — do not change funnel_ledger.py (not owned).
4. Backward compat: --roster omitted => old behavior is FORBIDDEN; instead collect with no roster treats EVERY sender as unclassified (fail-safe: nothing auto-enters the ledger). Update the module docstring.

TESTS (extend tests/test_funnel_evidence.py; keep every existing test green, adjusting only those that asserted the old sweep-everything behavior, and note each adjustment in a comment): at least 6 NEW 'def test_' functions: roster email match becomes a touch; roster normalized-name match becomes a touch; unknown human inbound lands in unclassified (not touches) with dedupe; noreply/newsletter/billing senders dropped into machine_dropped count; focus adds the single classify_inbound item at the right priority position when unclassified>0 and omits it at 0; no-roster mode sends everyone to unclassified and touches stays empty.

VERIFY: 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_funnel_evidence.py -q -p no:cacheprovider' green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 6 new tests, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: gmail collect is relevance-gated: known people become touches, unknown humans queue for LLM triage as one classify_inbound focus item, machine mail is dropped counted — vendors can no longer enter the guest ledger
